## We Are The Premier Agribusiness Solutions Company Built for the 21st Century


For generations, Bunge has nourished the world. Now, we’re redefining what’s possible. We have
evolved, transformed, and grown, building an irreplaceable global footprint and a team dedicated to
connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. With our
agile workforce, global footprint, increased access to markets, and agriculture network covering all
major crops, Bunge navigates seasonal cycles, weather, and other risks. We partner with farmers,
supply plant-based oils and proteins for food, provide essential animal feed ingredients, and
champion low-carbon feedstocks for renewable fuel.

## We Are The Premier Agribusiness Solutions Company Built for the 21st Century


For generations, Bunge has nourished the world. Now, we’re redefining what’s possible. We have
evolved, transformed, and grown, building an irreplaceable global footprint and a team dedicated to
connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. With our
agile workforce, global footprint, increased access to markets, and agriculture network covering all
major crops, Bunge navigates seasonal cycles, weather, and other risks. We partner with farmers,
supply plant-based oils and proteins for food, provide essential animal feed ingredients, and
champion low-carbon feedstocks for renewable fuel.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Culturelle® Medical Advisory Board


Our Microbiome Medical Advisory Board reflects our commitment to leveraging clinical evidence to
deliver microbiome-targeted solutions for your patients. Made up of trusted health care
professionals who truly understand the vital role the microbiome plays in overall wellness, the
Board helps guide our product innovation and clinical development with a focus on rigorous safety
standards and clinical efficacy. The Board is composed of health care professionals with extensive
clinical and research experience who provide strategic expertise across innovation, clinical
development, and medical education.

The Board supports the translation of emerging and established microbiome science into clinically
relevant solutions and contributes to the education of both health care providers and patients on
microbiome-targeted health solutions, with a focus on safety, scientific rigor, and clinical
relevance.

The Microbiome Medical Advisory Board is chaired by i-Health’s Global Scientific Engagement Leader,
Shavon Jackson-Michel, ND.

## Meet Our Board

#### Dr. Shavon Jackson-Michel

##### ND | Board Chair

Naturopathic Doctor and trained, biomedical engineer at the interface of product development,
clinical research and implementation science. Medical affairs and business development leader niched
in advancing researched, natural actives and botanical drugs across commercial pipelines and global
markets.

[ ** READ MORE ][22]

#### Dr. Vivian Asamoah

##### MD, FACG, IFMCP

John Hopkins fellowed and board-certified Gastroenterologist, Hepatologist and Nutrition expert.
IFM-certified Integrative Medicine practitioner. CEO of Houston Gastro Institute, practicing
physician, researcher, medical consultant, microbiome champion and educator. 

[ ** READ MORE ][23]

      

#### Dr. Jon Vanderhoof

##### MD

UCLA-fellowed Pediatric Gastroenterologist and researcher with 200+ publications. Chief of Pediatric
Gastroenterology at the Boystown NatResearch Center, attending at Boston Children’s and Senior
Lecturer at Harvard Medical School. Revered industry scientist, probiotics pioneer, and NASPGHAN
past president/awardee.

[ ** READ MORE ][24]

#### Dr. Whitney Casares

##### MD, MPH, FAAP

Stanford University and UC Berkely trained, board-certified Pediatrician and maternal and child
health Public Health specialist. A two-time American Academy of Pediatrics Author and Spokesperson,
private practice physician, consultant and educator. 

[ ** READ MORE ][25]

## Advisory Board Goals

#### Reinforced Credibility

Our brands have always held a credible standing – buoyed by our science and commitment to quality,
but this board will take this positioning to the next level, reinforcing and extending our reach not
only as a leader, but as an authority.

#### Expert Insights

Our Medical Advisory Board will provide key insights at a closer clip than ever! This fresh angle
will complement the advanced, metrics-driven, consumer-focused data that has always informed our
processes, innovations and positioning—supercharging our successes.

#### Thought Leadership

Holding brands with 20 and 30-year lifecycles, we know that success is a healthy combination of
courage, consistency and continuous evolution. Our boards boast 4x that in combined legacy &
experience, expanding the breadth of our excellence as an industry vanguard for decades to come.

#### Are you a healthcare Professional?

The information on this site is intended for healthcare professionals in the United States and is
not intended for the general public.

[ No ][26]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]
* [ [automotice]Automotive ][169]
* [ [Building]Building & Construction ][170]
* [ [Consumer]Consumer ][171]
* [ [Electrical]Electrical & Electronics ][172]
* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]
* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]
* [ [automotice]Automotive ][169]
* [ [Building]Building & Construction ][170]
* [ [Consumer]Consumer ][171]
* [ [Electrical]Electrical & Electronics ][172]
* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]
* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

## Our Global Export Market

## Our Business

Apical Group is a leading vegetable oil processor with an expanding global footprint. Our vertically
integrated mid-stream refining and value-added downstream processing makes us an integral supplier
that supports the food, feed, oleochemicals and renewable fuel needs across industries.

Download our [brochures][51] to find our more about our products.

##### Oleochemicals

Our portfolio includes a wide range of oleochemicals such as fatty acid, soap noodles, glycerin, and
more.

##### Functional & Specialty Fats


We deliver a range of quality edible oils and its derivatives used by consumer goods manufacturers
globally for food and non-food applications.

##### Renewable Fuel

We produce biodiesel through the processing of palm oil at our facilities.

##### Circular Economy

### Our Products

Our vertically integrated operations allow us to produce a high standard of innovative products for
our customers. The benefits are competitive prices, consistent supply, product quality and
customised solutions.

[Explore our full product range][52]

### Responsible Sourcing & Production

For improved agricultural practices, we identify priority suppliers to engage with. We are also
committed to producing high quality palm oil products efficiently, safely and responsibly in our
internationally certified refineries.

[Find out more][53]

Di Apical Group, komitmen kami terhadap keberlanjutan berasal dari tingkat pimpinan tertinggi.
Presiden Apical didukung oleh Direktur Keberlanjutan dan berbagai pimpinan unit bisnis untuk
memastikan bahwa keberlanjutan terintegrasi dalam unit bisnis dan fungsional, serta tertanam dalam
nilai dan inisiatif utama perusahaan.

Topik keberlanjutan dibahas dalam rapat Dewan Direksi yang diadakan setiap kuartal. Kami juga
memiliki tim Keberlanjutan khusus yang berbasis di Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, serta di Pekanbaru,
Dumai, Medan, Jakarta, dan Balikpapan di Indonesia. Tim Keberlanjutan bertugas untuk melaksanakan
dan memantau komitmen kami melalui keterlibatan dan kolaborasi konstruktif dengan para pemangku
kepentingan.

Selain itu, terdapat departemen Sosial, Keamanan, dan Perizinan (SSL) di setiap kilang yang kami
miliki, yang menangani urusan sosial dan perizinan sesuai dengan peraturan nasional serta Kebijakan
Keberlanjutan Apical. Tim ini juga mengawasi program Tanggung Jawab Sosial Perusahaan (CSR) untuk
mendukung peningkatan kesejahteraan masyarakat setempat.

Mewujudkan tujuan keberlanjutan memerlukan lebih dari sekadar kolaborasi dengan para pemangku
kepentingan utama kami. Kolaborasi lintas industri dan dengan perusahaan sejenis juga sangat
penting, oleh karena itu kami terus mencari dan berpartisipasi dalam kemitraan baru, keanggotaan
industri yang relevan, serta skema sertifikasi.

Kami berpartisipasi dalam keanggotaan industri dan skema sertifikasi seperti Tropical Forest
Alliance 2020, Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) — termasuk RSPO P&C Review Taskforce dan
RSPO Indonesia National Interpretation Working Group, International Sustainability and Carbon
Certification (ISCC), serta Indonesian Sustainable Palm Oil (ISPO).

At Apical Group, our commitment to sustainability stems right from the top. Apical’s President is
supported by the Director of Sustainability and various business heads, to ensure sustainability is
integrated within business and functional units, and embedded in the company’s core values and
initiatives.

Sustainability topics are discussed at Board meetings held quarterly. We also have dedicated
Sustainability teams based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, and Pekanbaru, Dumai, Medan, Jakarta and
Balikpapan in Indonesia. The Sustainability teams are tasked with implementing and monitoring our
commitments through constructive stakeholder engagement and collaboration.

In addition, there is also a dedicated Social, Security and Licensing (SSL) department in each
refinery we own, to handle social and licensing matters in compliance with national regulations as
well as the Apical Sustainability Policy. The team also oversees Corporate Social Responsibility
(CSR) programmes to support better livelihoods in local communities.

Achieving sustainability goals requires more than just collaboration with our key stakeholders.
Collaboration across industries and peer companies are also crucial and hence, we constantly look
for and participate in new partnerships, relevant industry membership and certification schemes.

We participate in industry membership and certification schemes such as the Tropical Forest Alliance
2020, Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO), including the RSPO P&C Review Taskforce and the
RSPO Indonesia National Interpretation Working Group, the International Sustainability and Carbon
Certification (ISCC), and the Indonesian Sustainable Palm Oil (ISPO).

nilai dan inisiatif utama perusahaan.

Topik keberlanjutan dibahas dalam rapat Dewan Direksi yang diadakan setiap kuartal. Kami juga
memiliki tim Keberlanjutan khusus yang berbasis di Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, serta di Pekanbaru,
Dumai, Medan, Jakarta, dan Balikpapan di Indonesia. Tim Keberlanjutan bertugas untuk melaksanakan
dan memantau komitmen kami melalui keterlibatan dan kolaborasi konstruktif dengan para pemangku
kepentingan.

Selain itu, terdapat departemen Sosial, Keamanan, dan Perizinan (SSL) di setiap kilang yang kami
miliki, yang menangani urusan sosial dan perizinan sesuai dengan peraturan nasional serta Kebijakan
Keberlanjutan Apical. Tim ini juga mengawasi program Tanggung Jawab Sosial Perusahaan (CSR) untuk
mendukung peningkatan kesejahteraan masyarakat setempat.

Mewujudkan tujuan keberlanjutan memerlukan lebih dari sekadar kolaborasi dengan para pemangku
kepentingan utama kami. Kolaborasi lintas industri dan dengan perusahaan sejenis juga sangat
penting, oleh karena itu kami terus mencari dan berpartisipasi dalam kemitraan baru, keanggotaan
industri yang relevan, serta skema sertifikasi.

Kami berpartisipasi dalam keanggotaan industri dan skema sertifikasi seperti Tropical Forest
Alliance 2020, Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) — termasuk RSPO P&C Review Taskforce dan
RSPO Indonesia National Interpretation Working Group, International Sustainability and Carbon
Certification (ISCC), serta Indonesian Sustainable Palm Oil (ISPO).

Close this module

At Apical Group, our commitment to sustainability stems right from the top. Apical’s President is
supported by the Director of Sustainability and various business heads, to ensure sustainability is
integrated within business and functional units, and embedded in the company’s core values and
initiatives.

Sustainability topics are discussed at Board meetings held quarterly. We also have dedicated
Sustainability teams based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, and Pekanbaru, Dumai, Medan, Jakarta and
Balikpapan in Indonesia. The Sustainability teams are tasked with implementing and monitoring our
commitments through constructive stakeholder engagement and collaboration.

In addition, there is also a dedicated Social, Security and Licensing (SSL) department in each
refinery we own, to handle social and licensing matters in compliance with national regulations as
well as the Apical Sustainability Policy. The team also oversees Corporate Social Responsibility
(CSR) programmes to support better livelihoods in local communities.

Achieving sustainability goals requires more than just collaboration with our key stakeholders.
Collaboration across industries and peer companies are also crucial and hence, we constantly look
for and participate in new partnerships, relevant industry membership and certification schemes.

We participate in industry membership and certification schemes such as the Tropical Forest Alliance
2020, Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO), including the RSPO P&C Review Taskforce and the
RSPO Indonesia National Interpretation Working Group, the International Sustainability and Carbon
Certification (ISCC), and the Indonesian Sustainable Palm Oil (ISPO).

# Fortifying Molecules of Life to Prevent Cellular Degeneration

[ » learn more ][18]

# Fortifying Molecules of Life to Prevent Cellular Degeneration

[ » learn more ][19]

## about us

### Company Overview

BioJiva is a clinical stage pharmaceutical company pioneering the development of first-in-class
therapeutics to treat degenerative diseases resulting from Lipid peroxidation (LPO). BioJiva has
developed a series of oxidation resistant armored Polyunsaturated Fatty Acids (PUFAs) as drug
interventions to mitigate LPO.

At the forefront of scientific innovation, our team specializes in lipid biology, natural lipid
peroxidation (LPO) process and its critical role in disease progression. Our first-in-class new
chemical entities (NCEs) are isotopically stabilized synthetic polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs)
designed to mitigate oxidative stress and cellular degeneration caused by LPO, thus addressing the
root causes of various degenerative conditions.

### Mission

With a team of world-class chemists, biologists and ophthalmology experts, we are uniquely equipped
to tackle degenerative eye diseases, including age-related macular degeneration (AMD). Together, we
are committed to delivering transformative therapies that improve lives.

## Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD)

Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD) is a progressive eye disease and one of the leading causes of
vision loss worldwide, particularly in individuals over 50.

[ » learn more ][20]

Late stage age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD) causes central blindness.

device (Android and iOS). To get started, simply download the Brave browser [for desktop][52], [for
Android][53], or [for iOS][54].

outside the Brave Browser*. One subscription covers up to 5 devices, across Android, iOS, and
desktop.

pre-roll and mid-roll ads, end-card ads, and more. By blocking ads, you get a cleaner experience and
faster video load. [Learn more about Brave’s YouTube ad blocking.][56]

Brave browser. It’s also [available in any other browser][57] at search.brave.com. Brave Search
serves fast, accurate results from its own independent index of the Web, and offers unique features
like a powerful AI-answer engine. Unlike some other search engines, Brave Search doesn’t profile
you; it can’t share, sell, or lose your personal data, because it’s not collected in the first
place. [Learn more about Brave Search.][58]

What languages is Brave available in?

Chinese. Brave Search is currently available in almost 20 different languages, with support for even
more languages on the horizon.

independent, privately-held company. Brave is not beholden to any other tech company, and works
every single day to fight Big Tech’s terrible privacy abuses. Brave exists to help real people, not
some faceless tech company.

released under the [Mozilla Public License 2.0][59].

ads & trackers by default, there’s less stuff to load on every single webpage you visit. That means
pages load much faster, saving you time, money, and battery life. It also means you’re much safer
online. [Learn more][61].

Android][63], or [for iOS][64] to get started. You can also use Brave Search free from any browser
at search.brave.com, or [set it as your default search engine][65].

Brave also has some great, subscription-based features, including [Brave Talk Premium][66] and
[Brave Firewall + VPN][67].

part of the Brave Rewards ecosystem. Here’s how it works:

Brave Rewards gives you the option to view first-party, privacy-protecting ads while you browse
(these ads are from the Brave Private Ads network). If you choose to view them, you earn BAT via
[the Brave Rewards program][68].

Brave even gives you a secure way to store BAT (and any other asset), with [Brave Wallet][69]. And,
again, Brave Rewards is a totally optional program.

We think your attention is valuable (and private!), and that you should get a fair share of the
revenue for any advertising you choose to view. That fair share is rewarded in BAT.

Other tech companies steal your data to sell ads—to them, you are the product. Brave is different.

revenue for any advertising you choose to view. That fair share is rewarded in BAT.

# Cailà&Parés Empresa Oleoquímica

## Fabricación y Distribución de Productos Oleoquímicos

Cailà y Parés S.A. es una empresa oleoquímica con casi 100 años de historia realizando la
**fabricación ** y **distribución de ácidos y aceites grasos** a diferentes zonas del mundo. Puede
conocer más detalles sobre nuestra planta oleoquímica haciendo clic sobre los enlaces inferiores
para comenzar a navegar y conocer más sobre Cailà y Parés, como nuestros productos oleoquímicos, el
cumplimiento de la política medioambiental o conocer alguno de nuestros clientes internacionales.

### Fabricación de Ácidos Grasos fuera del ámbito de aplicación del EUDR (Non-EUDR)

Nuestros ácidos grasos Non-EUDR se fabrican en España utilizando materias primas de origen vegetal
fuera del alcance de la normativa EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation). Apostamos por un
abastecimiento responsable y sostenible, priorizando cadenas de suministro trazables y rutas
logísticas cortas dentro de Europa. Gracias al origen de nuestras materias primas y a la proximidad
de la cadena de suministro, contribuimos a reducir la huella de carbono asociada al producto y al
transporte.

### Venta de Ácidos Grasos y Especialidades Químicas para la Industria

Descubre nuestra empresa líder en la fabricación y distribución de productos oleoquímicos de alta
calidad. Ofrecemos una amplia gama de soluciones innovadoras y sostenibles para diversas
aplicaciones industriales. Nuestros [**productos oleoquímicos**][31], derivados de fuentes
naturales, **cumplen con los estándares más exigentes, garantizando eficacia, confiabilidad y
respeto por el medio ambiente.** Colaboramos estrechamente con nuestros clientes para satisfacer sus
necesidades específicas y proporcionar soluciones a medida. Explora nuestra gama de productos y
descubre cómo podemos impulsar el éxito de tu negocio con nuestros productos oleoquímicos de
vanguardia.

## Especialistas en aceites naturales y derivados oleoquímicos

# Cailà&Parés Empresa Oleoquímica

## Fabricación y Distribución de Productos Oleoquímicos

Cailà y Parés S.A. es una empresa oleoquímica con casi 100 años de historia realizando la
**fabricación ** y **distribución de ácidos y aceites grasos** a diferentes zonas del mundo. Puede
conocer más detalles sobre nuestra planta oleoquímica haciendo clic sobre los enlaces inferiores
para comenzar a navegar y conocer más sobre Cailà y Parés, como nuestros productos oleoquímicos, el
cumplimiento de la política medioambiental o conocer alguno de nuestros clientes internacionales.

### Fabricación de Ácidos Grasos fuera del ámbito de aplicación del EUDR (Non-EUDR)

Nuestros ácidos grasos Non-EUDR se fabrican en España utilizando materias primas de origen vegetal
fuera del alcance de la normativa EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation). Apostamos por un
abastecimiento responsable y sostenible, priorizando cadenas de suministro trazables y rutas
logísticas cortas dentro de Europa. Gracias al origen de nuestras materias primas y a la proximidad
de la cadena de suministro, contribuimos a reducir la huella de carbono asociada al producto y al
transporte.

### Venta de Ácidos Grasos y Especialidades Químicas para la Industria

Descubre nuestra empresa líder en la fabricación y distribución de productos oleoquímicos de alta
calidad. Ofrecemos una amplia gama de soluciones innovadoras y sostenibles para diversas
aplicaciones industriales. Nuestros [**productos oleoquímicos**][31], derivados de fuentes
naturales, **cumplen con los estándares más exigentes, garantizando eficacia, confiabilidad y
respeto por el medio ambiente.** Colaboramos estrechamente con nuestros clientes para satisfacer sus
necesidades específicas y proporcionar soluciones a medida. Explora nuestra gama de productos y
descubre cómo podemos impulsar el éxito de tu negocio con nuestros productos oleoquímicos de
vanguardia.

Ingredient (API) manufacturing company, has suc-cessfully commissioned a new ground-mounted

underscores its long-term commitment to sustainability and the expansion of renewable energy.

# Equazen® is developed with you in mind

Equazen contains only high-quality ingredients sourced from sustainable fish and naturally sourced
primrose oil and borage oil. Our unique formulations provide balanced omega-3 and omega-6 to support
learning difficulties and brain function.

[Our Source to Patient philosophy ][23]

## The Equazen® difference

Discover what makes us different to other supplements.

[Science at the core]

### Science at the core

Everything we do is based on rigorous testing. We are continuously advancing our understanding of
essential fatty acids and how they work. Our products are clinically researched so we are confident
that we can pass on benefits to you.

[Explore our products ][24]
[Quality & Consistency]

### Quality & Consistency

The quality of supplements can vary based on the consistency of the ingredient used and the precise
care taken at each step of the production process. At Equazen®, quality and consistency is ensured
from sourcing all the way through to shipping.

[Why quality counts ][25]
[Tailored to you]

### Tailored to you

We know that essential fatty acids provide benefits for each phase of your life. That’s why we
produce specific formulations to meet the changing needs of each life stage.*****

# Leading the Evolution of Speciality Oleo Chemicals

Fairchem leads the Indian speciality chemicals industry as one of the established Chemical Companies
in India and a trusted [Oleochemicals][14] Company in India. As a quality-driven Chemical
Manufacturing Company, we procure and refine by-products from vegetable oil refineries into valuable
ingredients used across high-value applications.

Recognized among progressive Specialty Chemical Companies in India, Fairchem contributes
significantly to the growing Oleochemical Industry in India by manufacturing performance-driven
Oleochemicals Products for nutraceutical, personal care, and industrial segments.

## About US

## Unveiling Fairchem

At Fairchem Organics Limited, we have built a dedicated platform to capitalize on the immense
opportunities within the Indian specialty chemical sector. Today, we are recognized among
progressive Chemical Companies in India and emerging leaders within the Oleochemical Industry in
India.

Our journey began with a vision to transform the industry, and today we stand as a trusted Chemical
Manufacturing Company delivering sustainable and value-driven solutions across industries.

[ Discover Our Impact ][15]

We have perfected a unique business model that revolves around procuring waste generated in
vegetable oil refining mills and converting it into high-value specialty ingredients. Through
advanced process technologies and operational excellence, we isolate and purify various components
that form the foundation of performance-driven Oleochemicals Products.

These include Isostearic Acid, Dimer Acid, Dimer Fatty Acid, and other specialty derivatives,
positioning us among reliable Oleochemicals Manufacturers in India and trusted Fatty Acid
Manufacturers in India. Our products serve diverse applications ranging from paints and coatings to
printing inks and industrial formulations.

Explore our journey, innovation capabilities, and commitment to shaping the future of specialty
chemicals in India.

## Explore Our Product Range

Explore our range of high-quality Oleochemicals Products and [nutraceutical][16] ingredients,
meticulously crafted for diverse industries. As one of the trusted Chemical Manufacturing Companies
in India, we deliver performance-driven solutions that support the growing Oleochemical Industry in
India and modern Nutraceuticals Manufacturing requirements.

Our commitment to excellence sets out the benchmark for innovation, sustainability, and product
reliability across specialty segments.

[ Discover Product ][17]

## Nutraceuticals

### The Power of Tocopherols

Our Mixed Tocopherols are a natural source of Vitamin E, a potent antioxidant known to support
wellness and slow down oxidative stress. As one of the trusted Tocopherol Manufacturers in India, we
specialize in producing high-quality Natural Vitamin E ingredients for diverse applications.

Recognized among reliable Natural Vitamin E Manufacturers and experienced Vitamin E Manufacturers in
India, Fairchem supplies refined tocopherol concentrates to global nutraceutical and wellness
brands. Our expertise in Nutraceuticals Manufacturing ensures consistent purity, stability, and
performance across formulations.

As dependable Tocopherol Suppliers and a quality-driven Vitamin E Oil Manufacturer in India, we
support customers with sustainable, traceable, and regulatory-compliant solutions designed to
enhance health-focused product development.

[ Learn More ][18]
[Tocopherol Manufacturer]

## Oleochemicals

### Transforming Fatty Acids

Unlock the potential of long-chain Fatty Acids with our high-grade Dimer Acid and specialty
derivatives. As a leading Oleochemicals Company in India, Fairchem transforms by-products of
vegetable oil refining into performance-driven Oleochemicals Products that support multiple
industries.

Derived from acid oil, our solutions include Dimer Fatty Acid, Isostearic Acid, and other specialty
materials, positioning us among reliable Oleochemicals Manufacturers in India and trusted Fatty Acid
Manufacturers in India. Our products serve applications across coatings, adhesives, inks,
lubricants, and industrial formulations.

Recognized within the evolving Oleochemical Industry in India, we are also dependable Fatty Acid
Suppliers in India, delivering consistent quality, regulatory compliance, and sustainable sourcing
to global markets.

[ Discover More ][19]
[Fatty Acid]

## our certifications

Our certifications reflect our commitment to quality, sustainability, and global compliance. With
ISO, REACH, Halal, and Kosher approvals, Fairchem ensures trusted and responsible manufacturing
standards.
* ISO 9001:   2015 (Quality Management)
* ISO 14001: 2015 (Environmental Management

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

### Standards

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

* [Detail of an Indian miniature painting depicting Krishna, a blue-skinned figure in a crown and
  yellow garments, seated on a platform reading a letter inviting him to a svayamvara (marriage
  ceremony). A messenger in white robes stands before him in reverence, while an attendant with a
  staff stands in an alcove to the left. The scene is set against a vibrant red background within an
  architectural frame.]
* [Detail of an impressionistic painting by Ion Bitan titled "Landscape from Bucharest," featuring a
  person in a red hooded coat standing before two red and white streetcars during a heavy snowfall.
  The scene is rendered with thick, textured brushstrokes and shows colorful buildings in the
  background.]
* [Detail of a traditional Chinese handscroll painting titled "Old Pine Tree" by Ming dynasty artist
  Wen Zhengming, depicting a gnarled and vine-entangled tree in expressive monochrome ink. The long
  composition is annotated with vertical calligraphy and multiple red artist seals on the left.]
* [Detail of a black and white photograph by Chris Steele-Perkins depicting American civil rights
  activist Jesse Jackson during a 1990 visit to Soweto, South Africa. Jackson is surrounded by a
  dense press scrum of journalists, cameras, and microphones against a backdrop of anti-apartheid
  signage.]
* [Detail of a wide Impressionist painting by Claude Monet of his water lily pond at Giverny. The
  composition features clusters of pale water lilies floating on a shimmering surface of deep
  purples, blues, and greens, rendered with soft, blended brushstrokes and no visible horizon.]

## Cod liver oil is a good source of omega-3, vitamin A and D

Immune system. Cod liver oil is a one of the best sources of omega-3, with the added benefit that it
contains vitamin A and D. These vitamins support a normal functioning immune system. 

[Møllers Amazon - Rania (15)]

## Cod liver oil contains vitamin D which is an important nutrient for both adults and children

Another benefit of cod liver oil  is the content of vitamin D which is an important nutrient for all
of us. It is needed for normal growth and development of bone in children. It helps the absorption
of calcium and phosphorus and it also contributes to the maintenance of normal teeth. 

[Møllers Amazon - My first cod liver oil - Rania & baby 2]

## DHA omega-3 fatty acids to support your brain

Your all-important mental computer benefits from DHA omega-3 fatty acid. A daily intake of 250 mg
DHA contributes to the normal brain function

[Møllers Amazon - Jelly Fish - Alexandra 6]

## Support your eye health with DHA omega-3 fatty acid

As a unique nutrient in the retina, DHA contributes to the normal development of vision. In infants
up to 12 months of age the beneficial effect is obtained with a daily intake of 100 mg of DHA. Later
in life from the age of three years a daily intake of 250 mg DHA contributes to maintenance of
normal vision. 

[Møllers Amazon - Total - Ingvild & Elselill (10)]

## Take care of your heart

A daily intake of 2 g DHA and EPA contributes to the maintenance of normal blood triglyceride
levels. EPA and DHA also contributes to the normal function of the heart. The beneficial effect is
obtained with a daily intake of 250 mg EPA and DHA. 

[B17R4583]

## Support of muscles

If you take cod liver oil as a source of omega-3 later in life, you will benefit from the effects of
vitamin D. Vitamin D helps to maintain normal muscle function. 

[B17R4880]

## Omega-3 is important even before your baby is born

A mothers diet during pregnancy affects the health of her child, both in the womb and after birth,
during lactation. Parts of DHA omega-3 fatty acid ingested by the mother during pregnancy and
lactation is transferred to the child, thus contributing to the normal development of both the brain
and eye of the fetus and breastfed infants. The beneficial effect is obtained with a daily intake of
200 mg of DHA in addition to the recommended daily intake for omega-3 fatty acids for adults i.e.
250 mg DHA and EPA. 

[B17R6189]

biochemistry, medicine, and nutrition. Each piece is rigorously reviewed by our editorial staff and

As a trusted health information platform, we take this responsibility seriously and uphold the
highest standards by:

Charging our content creators to practice **journalistic principles** of excellence and provide
objective, accurate, and balanced reporting

## 02

Maintaining **editorial independence** and transparency into how we protect the integrity of our
content

## 03

Regularly reviewing and updating our content by working with our network of **doctors and health
experts**

## Apollo 13 A Successful Failure

[Blue paper]
[Apollo 13 space vehicle rollout from Vehicle Assembly Building]

Apollo 13 launch

Play video Pause video
[The Apollo 13 Saturn V yaws away from the launch tower during liftoff]

### Heading for the Moon

On April 11 1970, NASA’s third crewed lunar landing, Apollo 13 set out for the Fra Mauro highlands
to continue humankind’s exploration of the Moon.

[Red paper]
[Picture of the Moon from Apollo 13]
[Apollo 13's 4th TV tranmission with trouble only minutes away]
[View of the crippled Service Module]

### “Houston, we have had a problem.”

Two days into the flight, an oxygen tank ruptures and cripples the service module. The lunar landing
is abandoned, and the mission’s single objective becomes bringing three astronauts home.

[Blue paper]
[Picture of the Moon from Apollo 13"]
[Picture of the Earth from Apollo 13]
[Close-up of a Speedmaster Moonwatch worn by an astronaut]
[310.30.42.50.01.001]

### Moonwatch's Role

With the spacecraft powered down to conserve energy, the crew had to time a critical engine burn
entirely by hand. Fourteen seconds, exactly, to set their course for Earth. They measured it on an
OMEGA Speedmaster.

[ Discover the watch ][148]
[Red paper]
[Apollo 13 splashes down] [Apollo 13 splashes down]

Apollo 13 splashes down

Play video Pause video
[Astronauts being rescued]

### Return to Earth

Sheltered in the lunar module, the crew splashed down safely in the South Pacific on April 17 1970,
bringing home what NASA would call later “a successful failure”.

[Blue paper]
[Snoopy sliver Award]
[Astronaut touching a Snoopy teddy bear before departure]
[Silver Snoopy Award certificate]
[Apollo 13 mission patch]
[310.32.42.50.02.001]

### NASA’s tribute

In recognition of the Speedmaster’s role, OMEGA received the Silver Snoopy Award, a rare honour
given by NASA’s astronauts for outstanding contributions to flight safety.

## Apollo 13 A Successful Failure

[Blue paper]
[Apollo 13 space vehicle rollout from Vehicle Assembly Building]

Apollo 13 launch

Play video Pause video
[The Apollo 13 Saturn V yaws away from the launch tower during liftoff]

### Heading for the Moon

On April 11 1970, NASA’s third crewed lunar landing, Apollo 13 set out for the Fra Mauro highlands
to continue humankind’s exploration of the Moon.

[Red paper]
[Picture of the Moon from Apollo 13]
[Apollo 13's 4th TV tranmission with trouble only minutes away]
[View of the crippled Service Module]

### “Houston, we have had a problem.”

Two days into the flight, an oxygen tank ruptures and cripples the service module. The lunar landing
is abandoned, and the mission’s single objective becomes bringing three astronauts home.

[Blue paper]
[Picture of the Moon from Apollo 13"]
[Picture of the Earth from Apollo 13]
[Close-up of a Speedmaster Moonwatch worn by an astronaut]
[310.30.42.50.01.001]

### Moonwatch's Role

With the spacecraft powered down to conserve energy, the crew had to time a critical engine burn
entirely by hand. Fourteen seconds, exactly, to set their course for Earth. They measured it on an
OMEGA Speedmaster.

[ Discover the watch ][148]
[Red paper]
[Apollo 13 splashes down] [Apollo 13 splashes down]

Apollo 13 splashes down

Play video Pause video
[Astronauts being rescued]

### Return to Earth

Sheltered in the lunar module, the crew splashed down safely in the South Pacific on April 17 1970,
bringing home what NASA would call later “a successful failure”.

[Blue paper]
[Snoopy sliver Award]
[Astronaut touching a Snoopy teddy bear before departure]
[Silver Snoopy Award certificate]
[Apollo 13 mission patch]
[310.32.42.50.02.001]

### NASA’s tribute

In recognition of the Speedmaster’s role, OMEGA received the Silver Snoopy Award, a rare honour
given by NASA’s astronauts for outstanding contributions to flight safety.

## Used by Over 2000 Companies

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

# ******Leading Malaysia Bulk Palm Oil Supplier for Global Importers & Distributors******

[Get a Quote][20]

## Why Choose PalmAzia?

### High-Quality Palm Oil Production • Factory Supply • Global Export

*PalmAzia is a palm oil production, manufacturing, and export company based in Malaysia.* The
world’s largest palm oil regions. *PalmAzia* supplies **Crude Palm Oil (CPO), RBD Palm Olein (CP6 /
CP8 / CP10), Stearin, and Palm Kernel Oil** in bulk to importers, factories, bottling companies, and
distributors across the world.

Our goal is simple: **consistent quality, reliable export logistics, and competitive pricing –
directly from source.**

[Get A Quote][21]

## PalmAzia

### ***From Malaysia to the world: PalmAzia, your go-to source for export-ready palm oil in bulk.***

### Palm Oil Bulk Supply

A reliable factory-direct solution for importing **CPO, RBD Olein, Stearin, PKO and PFAD** in large
industrial volumes.

### White Label & OEM Packing

We produce and pack palm oil under your brand, offering **custom bottles, labels, and packaging**
for retail and wholesale markets.

### Flexitank & Industrial Export Packaging

Efficient bulk transport options including **Flexitanks, IBC tanks, steel drums and jerrycans**,
designed for global CIF/FOB shipping.

## A single source for production, packaging and export of palm oil at scale.

[Get A Quote][22]

## Solutions we Provide

Flexitank • IBC Tank • Steel Drums • Jerrycans • Customized Bottling

[Packaged Palm Oil Supply]

### Packaged Palm Oil Supply

PalmAzia offers palm oil in a range of packaged formats designed for retail, foodservice, and
commercial distribution. These packaging solutions ensure product protection, freshness, and
efficient handling for both domestic and export markets.

**Available packaging formats & capacities:**
**PET bottles:** 500 ml, 1 L, 2 L, 3 L, 5 L
**Jerry cans:** 5 L, 10 L, 18 L, 20 L, 25 L
**Tins:** 15 kg, 18 kg, 20 kg
**Carton packs:** multi-unit retail and bulk logistics cartons

**Types of palm oil supplied:**
RBD Palm Olein (cooking & frying oil)
RBD Palm Oil
Palm Stearin (bakery & industrial applications)

[Palm Oil Manufacturer & Exporter]

### Palm Oil Manufacturer & Exporter

PalmAzia provides bulk palm oil supply through flexitank solutions, ideal for large-scale
industrial, commercial, and export requirements. Our flexitank options ensure safe, efficient, and
cost-effective transportation while maintaining product quality and integrity.

**Flexitank capacities:**
18,000 L – 25,000 L per tank (customizable based on shipment needs)

**Types of palm oil supplied:**
RBD Palm Olein (cooking & frying oil)
RBD Palm Oil
Palm Stearin (bakery & industrial applications)

**Key benefits of Flexitank supply:**
Efficient bulk transport in standard shipping containers
Minimized risk of contamination and product loss
Reduced handling and storage costs

[Packaged Palm Oil Ghee / Vegetable Ghee Supply]

### Packaged Palm Oil Ghee / Vegetable Ghee Supply

PalmAzia offers high-quality **palm oil ghee**, also known as **vegetable ghee**, in a range of
packaged formats for retail, foodservice, and commercial distribution. Our packaging ensures
freshness, consistent quality, and easy handling, ideal for both domestic and export markets.

**Available packaging formats & capacities:**
PET jars: 500 g, 1 kg, 2 kg, 5 kg
Tins: 10 kg, 15 kg, 20 kg
Multi-unit cartons: convenient for retail and bulk logistics

**Types of ghee supplied:**
Palm Oil Ghee / Vegetable Ghee (for cooking, frying, and bakery applications)

**Key benefits:**
Long shelf-life with quality preservation
Convenient and hygienic packaging for households and professional kitchens

## As a Malaysia-based palm oil factory specializing in bulk supply of CP6/CP8/CP10 grades for food
## manufacturing, cosmetics, and biodiesel

Every batch is monitored for consistency, purity, and moisture levels. Our supply chain follows the
regulatory frameworks of Malaysia with sustainability and certification expansion underway.

RSPO Sustainable Palm Oil
In pipeline (2025 target)
MSPO / ISPO Plantation Compliance
Progressive rollout
Halal Certification

ISO Quality Management

We prioritize traceability, lab testing, and responsible handling from origin to shipment.

# CREMER North America

# is your regional oleochemical supplier with a global reach

Our global network grants you access to oleochemical supplies, contract manufacturing, and
end-to-end solutions that help you improve your outcomes and reduce manufacturing costs.

CREMER has three North American facilities for oleochemical supply and manufacturing services
accessible throughout the United States and beyond. Extend your internal manufacturing capabilities
and drive growth with CREMER.
[CREMER NA has three locations in Ohio, Tennessee and Louisiana.]
[ Speak with a CREMER expert > ][37]

# INDUSTRIES WE SERVE

Our solutions provide the highest quality oleochemical supplies, toll manufacturing or end-to-end
services for global markets across these services and more. Let us know how we can help you.
Pet Care, Food & Treats
Personal Care & Cosmetics
Household & Industrial Cleaning
Adhesives. Sealings & Coatings
Lubricants & Greases
Food & Beverage
Pharmaceuticals
Agriculture
Rubber & Plastic Additives
Oil & Gas
[ CONTACT US > ][38]

# OLEOCHEMICALS WE SUPPLY

We provide kosher, non-kosher, and food-safe oleochemicals in volumes ranging from drum to tote to
tanker.
[ Oleochemicals ][39] [ Fatty Acids ][40] [ Fatty Alcohols ][41] [ Glycerin & Propylene Glycol ][42]
[ Methyl Esters ][43] [ Soap Noodles ][44]
[ CONTACT US > ][45]

# MANUFACTURING SOLUTIONS

We hold our manufacturing, logistics, and lab services to the highest standards to stay compliant
with our various certifications. We assess each manufacturing run and logistics plan to ensure
efficiency and sustainability in everything we do.
[ Contract Manufacturing ][46] [ Pastillation & Flaking ][47] [ Drumming & Toting ][48] [ Blending &
Diluting ][49] [ warehousing & Storage ][50] [ Lab Services ][51] [ Logistics ][52]
[ CONTACT US > ][53]

# THE OLEOCHEMICAL SUPPLIER OF CHOICE

## End-To-End

CREMER serves manufacturers and clients with high volume product lines who want to expand their
existing product lines, warehouse, or manufacturing processes. For those looking for oleochemical
supply, our volumes range from a single drum to a barge, with options for volume and material state.

CREMER has the technical expertise and supply dependability you need to innovate on new products or
increase your capacity.

Contact us for a custom plan built for the needs of your product.
[ CONTACT US > ][54]

## Sustainable

CREMER oleochemicals are plant-based, sustainable and safe solutions for personal care, pet treats,
pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, and industrial purposes.
[ CONTACT US > ][55]

## Timely

Our three locations across the North American interior connect businesses with the manufacturing,
logistics, and global oleochemical supply solutions they need, when they need them. With flexible
capacity across our sites, many projects begin production within six weeks.
[ CONTACT US > ][56]

## Accessible

Our facilities supply and ship to anywhere in North America or across the globe with access to the
Gulf of Mexico, Ohio and Mississippi Rivers, and connections to South American industrial
oleochemical suppliers within the CREMER network of suppliers. Our North American experts have
experience in every part of the logistics matrix, including: import, air and ocean export, barge,
flatbed, truck, rail, transloading, warehousing, and tank storage.
[ CONTACT US > ][57]

## Quality

CREMER adheres to the highest standards of quality to ensure consistent, reliable solutions. In our
Cincinnati, Ohio, location, we hold the following certifications and are registered with the FDA for
food and excipient ingredients. Our Health and Safety page goes into detail on the certifications
for each location.
[ CONTACT US > ][58]

# THE OLEOCHEMICAL SUPPLIER OF CHOICE

## End-To-End

CREMER serves manufacturers and clients with high volume product lines who want to expand their
existing product lines, warehouse, or manufacturing processes. For those looking for oleochemical
supply, our volumes range from a single drum to a barge, with options for volume and material state.

CREMER has the technical expertise and supply dependability you need to innovate on new products or
increase your capacity.

Contact us for a custom plan built for the needs of your product.
[ CONTACT US > ][54]

## Sustainable

CREMER oleochemicals are plant-based, sustainable and safe solutions for personal care, pet treats,
pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, and industrial purposes.
[ CONTACT US > ][55]

## Timely

Our three locations across the North American interior connect businesses with the manufacturing,
logistics, and global oleochemical supply solutions they need, when they need them. With flexible
capacity across our sites, many projects begin production within six weeks.
[ CONTACT US > ][56]

## Accessible

Our facilities supply and ship to anywhere in North America or across the globe with access to the
Gulf of Mexico, Ohio and Mississippi Rivers, and connections to South American industrial
oleochemical suppliers within the CREMER network of suppliers. Our North American experts have
experience in every part of the logistics matrix, including: import, air and ocean export, barge,
flatbed, truck, rail, transloading, warehousing, and tank storage.
[ CONTACT US > ][57]

## Quality

CREMER adheres to the highest standards of quality to ensure consistent, reliable solutions. In our
Cincinnati, Ohio, location, we hold the following certifications and are registered with the FDA for
food and excipient ingredients. Our Health and Safety page goes into detail on the certifications
for each location.
[ CONTACT US > ][58]

# P&G Chemicals develops bio-based materials that can be used in a wide range of applications.
* Our products are created from responsibly sourced natural feedstocks. [Learn more here][9].
* Our portfolio of fatty alcohols, fatty acids, methyl esters and glycerin offers you a choice of
  low carbon options, including carbon negative and near carbon neutral versions. [Learn more
  here][10].
* Suitable for use in a wide range of applications including: agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals,
  personal care, fabric & home care products and lubricants.

## New carbon footprint solutions

**P&G Chemicals offer a range of carbon footprint solutions to help meet your business needs and
those of your customers.**

Through a combination of sourcing and manufacturing expertise we are able to provide a range of
options.
Our Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) are calculated from cradle to gate and include biogenic uptake.

Regular

Our mainline offering provides a **lower carbon** footprint than industry average carbon footprint*.

[Learn More][11]

Low

Our premium offering has a **significantly lower carbon** footprint than industry average*, helping
you make progress on your decarbonization journey.

[Learn More][12]

Ultra Low

Our flagship offering is **carbon negative**, an ideal choice to help you develop carbon neutral
formulations.

[Learn More][13]

* based on ERASM 2017 SLE Project PKO data + PGC scope 1, 2 and 3. To learn more, please contact us
[here][14].

The methodology used to calculate the Carbon Footprint through our supply chain is based on the ISO
14067 standard and follows the **Together for Sustainability** guideline. It has been certified in
2024 by **TUV Rheinland**, an independent organization of experts. The Product Carbon Footprints
(PCF) offered under our 3 different solutions have been verified in 2024 by TÜV Rheinland.

## Our product range

## Fatty Alcohols

We offer mid and heavy cut fatty alcohols. Our manufacturing operations in Europe, Asia, and
Americas provide responsiveness and supply assurance across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][15]

## Fatty Acids

We offer a range of high purity short chain fatty acids, suitable for a wide range of applications
including MCTs (Medium-Chain Triglycerides), lubricants and agricultural chemical formulations.

[LEARN MORE][16]

## Glycerin

For over 160 years, we have produced high quality glycerin. Today our range includes USP and FCC
grade with GMP Certificate for Food (BRC, FSSC).

[LEARN MORE][17]

## Methyl Esters

Our portfolio of methyl esters includes a variety of broad and high purity cuts that can be supplied
across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][18]

## Get to know us

P&G Chemicals has been making products using naturally derived chemistry for over 160 years. We were
first established to deliver the high-quality ingredients and supply chains that Procter & Gamble
(our parent company) needed to develop our superior branded consumer products. Today our horizons
have broadened – so we serve not only P&G but leading chemical companies, in over 40 countries
across the globe, as a trusted supplier of naturally derived bio-solutions. 

[LEARN MORE][19]

## Sustainability

Our passion is to act as a catalyst for sustainable business growth – through responsibly sourced,
natural based low carbon products. With a global technical, manufacturing and supply chain network
based in North America, Europe and Asia, we think globally and act locally delivering quality,
reliablity and supply chain resilience.

Our products are designed with our impact, your impact and your customers needs in mind. We do this
by responsibly sourcing natural materials, creating products that enable our customers to reduce
their footprint and by driving positive impacts through partnerships and programs.

[LEARN MORE][20]

# P&G Chemicals develops bio-based materials that can be used in a wide range of applications.
* Our products are created from responsibly sourced natural feedstocks. [Learn more here][9].
* Our portfolio of fatty alcohols, fatty acids, methyl esters and glycerin offers you a choice of
  low carbon options, including carbon negative and near carbon neutral versions. [Learn more
  here][10].
* Suitable for use in a wide range of applications including: agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals,
  personal care, fabric & home care products and lubricants.

## New carbon footprint solutions

**P&G Chemicals offer a range of carbon footprint solutions to help meet your business needs and
those of your customers.**

Through a combination of sourcing and manufacturing expertise we are able to provide a range of
options.
Our Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) are calculated from cradle to gate and include biogenic uptake.

Regular

Our mainline offering provides a **lower carbon** footprint than industry average carbon footprint*.

[Learn More][11]

Low

Our premium offering has a **significantly lower carbon** footprint than industry average*, helping
you make progress on your decarbonization journey.

[Learn More][12]

Ultra Low

Our flagship offering is **carbon negative**, an ideal choice to help you develop carbon neutral
formulations.

[Learn More][13]

* based on ERASM 2017 SLE Project PKO data + PGC scope 1, 2 and 3. To learn more, please contact us
[here][14].

The methodology used to calculate the Carbon Footprint through our supply chain is based on the ISO
14067 standard and follows the **Together for Sustainability** guideline. It has been certified in
2024 by **TUV Rheinland**, an independent organization of experts. The Product Carbon Footprints
(PCF) offered under our 3 different solutions have been verified in 2024 by TÜV Rheinland.

## Our product range

## Fatty Alcohols

We offer mid and heavy cut fatty alcohols. Our manufacturing operations in Europe, Asia, and
Americas provide responsiveness and supply assurance across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][15]

## Fatty Acids

We offer a range of high purity short chain fatty acids, suitable for a wide range of applications
including MCTs (Medium-Chain Triglycerides), lubricants and agricultural chemical formulations.

[LEARN MORE][16]

## Glycerin

For over 160 years, we have produced high quality glycerin. Today our range includes USP and FCC
grade with GMP Certificate for Food (BRC, FSSC).

[LEARN MORE][17]

## Methyl Esters

Our portfolio of methyl esters includes a variety of broad and high purity cuts that can be supplied
across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][18]

## Get to know us

P&G Chemicals has been making products using naturally derived chemistry for over 160 years. We were
first established to deliver the high-quality ingredients and supply chains that Procter & Gamble
(our parent company) needed to develop our superior branded consumer products. Today our horizons
have broadened – so we serve not only P&G but leading chemical companies, in over 40 countries
across the globe, as a trusted supplier of naturally derived bio-solutions. 

[LEARN MORE][19]

## Sustainability

Our passion is to act as a catalyst for sustainable business growth – through responsibly sourced,
natural based low carbon products. With a global technical, manufacturing and supply chain network
based in North America, Europe and Asia, we think globally and act locally delivering quality,
reliablity and supply chain resilience.

Our products are designed with our impact, your impact and your customers needs in mind. We do this
by responsibly sourcing natural materials, creating products that enable our customers to reduce
their footprint and by driving positive impacts through partnerships and programs.

[LEARN MORE][20]

### Pourquoi choisir Polaris ?

#### Innovation

Polaris est expert depuis plus de 20 années dans le domaine de la lipochimie ou de la chimie des
lipides. L’expertise et la passion de Polaris dans ce domaine en fait un spécialiste de renom, et
plus particulièrement dans le traitement et la transformation des acides gras polyinsaturés par des
procédés de synthèse respectueux de l’environnement.

La spécialisation de Polaris dans la lipochimie se traduit par une forte expertise dans :
* La synthèse enzymatique et la synthèse d’actifs
* Le traitement et la valorisation des lipides: acides gras polyinsaturés

**Pour aller plus loin :**
* [Les brevets][39]
* [Recherche et partenariats][40]

#### Expertise

Polaris est expert de premier rang au niveau mondial dans les lipides fonctionnels. La société est
spécialiste de la production, du développement et de la formulation des acides gras polyinsaturés et
notamment des Oméga-3. Ses équipes ont développé et mis sur le marché plusieurs innovations visant à
améliorer la qualité, la stabilité et la formulation d’[huiles à haute valeur nutritionnelle riches
en Oméga-3][41].

Polaris a notamment développé un brevet sur l’enrichissement naturel des huiles de poissons riches
en acides gras [Oméga-3 EPA][42] et [DHA][43], ainsi qu’une technique exclusive appelée «
[Qualitysilver®][44]» qui stabilise les huiles polyinsaturées, qu’elles soient d’origine marine ou
végétale. Afin de garantir des huiles de très haute qualité Polaris a également mis en place un
panel de testeur pour assurer à la gamme d’huiles des qualités organoleptiques incomparables.

**Pour aller plus loin :**
* [Qualitysilver®, la stabilité assurée][45]
* [Sensory][46][®][47][, la performance organoleptique][48]
* [Greensilver][49][®][50]

#### Engagement durable

L’OMS recommande à tous, des nourrissons aux personnes âgées de consommer 250 mg d’Omega-3 par jour
pour vivre en bonne santé. C’est pourquoi Polaris s’engage depuis des années pour préserver le
milieu marin en utilisant et valorisant les co-produits de la pêche (têtes de poissons).

Aujourd’hui pour mener à bien cette mission Polaris oriente le coeur de sa stratégie CER vers la
durabilité, en développant sa production d’[huiles de microalgues][51] naturellement riches en
Omega-3, ressource renouvelable et vegan.

### Pourquoi choisir Polaris ?

#### Innovation

Polaris est expert depuis plus de 20 années dans le domaine de la lipochimie ou de la chimie des
lipides. L’expertise et la passion de Polaris dans ce domaine en fait un spécialiste de renom, et
plus particulièrement dans le traitement et la transformation des acides gras polyinsaturés par des
procédés de synthèse respectueux de l’environnement.

La spécialisation de Polaris dans la lipochimie se traduit par une forte expertise dans :
* La synthèse enzymatique et la synthèse d’actifs
* Le traitement et la valorisation des lipides: acides gras polyinsaturés

**Pour aller plus loin :**
* [Les brevets][39]
* [Recherche et partenariats][40]

#### Expertise

Polaris est expert de premier rang au niveau mondial dans les lipides fonctionnels. La société est
spécialiste de la production, du développement et de la formulation des acides gras polyinsaturés et
notamment des Oméga-3. Ses équipes ont développé et mis sur le marché plusieurs innovations visant à
améliorer la qualité, la stabilité et la formulation d’[huiles à haute valeur nutritionnelle riches
en Oméga-3][41].

Polaris a notamment développé un brevet sur l’enrichissement naturel des huiles de poissons riches
en acides gras [Oméga-3 EPA][42] et [DHA][43], ainsi qu’une technique exclusive appelée «
[Qualitysilver®][44]» qui stabilise les huiles polyinsaturées, qu’elles soient d’origine marine ou
végétale. Afin de garantir des huiles de très haute qualité Polaris a également mis en place un
panel de testeur pour assurer à la gamme d’huiles des qualités organoleptiques incomparables.

**Pour aller plus loin :**
* [Qualitysilver®, la stabilité assurée][45]
* [Sensory][46][®][47][, la performance organoleptique][48]
* [Greensilver][49][®][50]

#### Engagement durable

L’OMS recommande à tous, des nourrissons aux personnes âgées de consommer 250 mg d’Omega-3 par jour
pour vivre en bonne santé. C’est pourquoi Polaris s’engage depuis des années pour préserver le
milieu marin en utilisant et valorisant les co-produits de la pêche (têtes de poissons).

Aujourd’hui pour mener à bien cette mission Polaris oriente le coeur de sa stratégie CER vers la
durabilité, en développant sa production d’[huiles de microalgues][51] naturellement riches en
Omega-3, ressource renouvelable et vegan.

## [Trend Watch: The Plant-Based Pivot][154]

[Janet Helm, MS, RDN][Janet Helm, MS, RDN][155]

After years of explosive trial, sales of plant-based meat alternatives have leveled off or
declined.1 Flavor and texture challenges, paired with a growing unease about overprocessing, made it
difficult for the category to sustain momentum.

## [Trend Watch: Mad About Matcha][156]

[Janet Helm, MS, RDN][Janet Helm, MS, RDN][157]

Matcha has evolved from a traditional Japanese tea ceremony staple to one of the fastest-growing
beverage trends worldwide. This article explores the rise of matcha in cafés, social media, and food
products—while examining the science behind its health claims and the cultural roots behind the
green tea powder.

## [Nutrition Therapy for Chronic Critical Illness][158]

[Jennifer Doley, MBA, RD, CNSC, FAND][Jennifer Doley, MBA, RD, CNSC, FAND][159]

Patients with chronic critical illness face profound nutrition challenges after the ICU. Targeted
nutrition therapy plays a critical role in recovery, functional improvement, and long-term outcomes.

## [Trend Watch: The Plant-Based Pivot][154]

[Janet Helm, MS, RDN][Janet Helm, MS, RDN][155]

After years of explosive trial, sales of plant-based meat alternatives have leveled off or
declined.1 Flavor and texture challenges, paired with a growing unease about overprocessing, made it
difficult for the category to sustain momentum.

## [Trend Watch: Mad About Matcha][156]

[Janet Helm, MS, RDN][Janet Helm, MS, RDN][157]

Matcha has evolved from a traditional Japanese tea ceremony staple to one of the fastest-growing
beverage trends worldwide. This article explores the rise of matcha in cafés, social media, and food
products—while examining the science behind its health claims and the cultural roots behind the
green tea powder.

## [Nutrition Therapy for Chronic Critical Illness][158]

[Jennifer Doley, MBA, RD, CNSC, FAND][Jennifer Doley, MBA, RD, CNSC, FAND][159]

Patients with chronic critical illness face profound nutrition challenges after the ICU. Targeted
nutrition therapy plays a critical role in recovery, functional improvement, and long-term outcomes.

## Products We Offer

### **USP & NF Oils**

[USP and NF grade pharmaceutical oil testing, WHC supplies FDA registered food grade and
pharmaceutical grade oils]

The United States Pharmacopeia (USP) & the National Formulary (NF) serve as a vital single-volume
compilation resource for public pharmacopoeia standards, encompassing guidelines for medicines,
dosage forms, drug substances, excipients, medical devices, and dietary supplements.

*see [products page][20] for more information.

### **Edible Vegetable Oils**

[Wholesale edible vegetable oils in bulk, USP/NF certified oils, WHC supplies refined food-grade
oils to food manufacturers and pet food producers]

As a well-established leader in the vegetable oil industry, we are committed to offering an
extensive range of products to meet diverse needs including edible and industrial oils.

*see [products page][21] for more information.

### **Fatty Acids**

[WHC wholesale fatty acids and specialty oils, Beef Tallow, Lard, and Coconut Fatty Acid supplier
for cosmetic and soap manufacturing]

As a supplier of high-quality animal fats and fatty acids, we serve a diverse array of industries
from food products to ingredients for paints and many other industrial uses.

*see [products page][22] for more information.

WHC is one of the United States' longest-operating wholesale industrial oil suppliers, providing
food-grade, USP/NF, and specialty oils to manufacturers nationwide since 1838.

# **Over 185 Years of Service, ****Integrity,**** and ****Dependability**

## Products We Offer

### **USP & NF Oils**

[USP and NF grade pharmaceutical oil testing, WHC supplies FDA registered food grade and
pharmaceutical grade oils]

The United States Pharmacopeia (USP) & the National Formulary (NF) serve as a vital single-volume
compilation resource for public pharmacopoeia standards, encompassing guidelines for medicines,
dosage forms, drug substances, excipients, medical devices, and dietary supplements.

*see [products page][20] for more information.

### **Edible Vegetable Oils**

[Wholesale edible vegetable oils in bulk, USP/NF certified oils, WHC supplies refined food-grade
oils to food manufacturers and pet food producers]

As a well-established leader in the vegetable oil industry, we are committed to offering an
extensive range of products to meet diverse needs including edible and industrial oils.

*see [products page][21] for more information.

### **Fatty Acids**

[WHC wholesale fatty acids and specialty oils, Beef Tallow, Lard, and Coconut Fatty Acid supplier
for cosmetic and soap manufacturing]

As a supplier of high-quality animal fats and fatty acids, we serve a diverse array of industries
from food products to ingredients for paints and many other industrial uses.

*see [products page][22] for more information.

WHC is one of the United States' longest-operating wholesale industrial oil suppliers, providing
food-grade, USP/NF, and specialty oils to manufacturers nationwide since 1838.
